title: docs: adopt the 'ontology is the software' positioning (README, landing page, glossary, concepts)
body:
Fixes #21574

Clause-②: no

Adopts the three-line positioning ruled on the card. Docs and copy only; nothing under `packages/**`, `content/docs/references/**`, `content/docs/releases/**`, any CHANGELOG, or the dated blog post is touched. No new page, no `meta.json` change.

## What changed

- Slogan: 本体即软件。 / The ontology is the software.
- Descriptor: 一份可执行的业务本体。AI 写，运行时跑，Agent 用，归你所有。 / One executable business ontology. AI writes it, the runtime runs it, agents operate it, you own it.
- Proof line, kept and demoted: 装得下，才管得住。 / Apps small enough for AI to hold whole.

Surfaces:

- `README.md`: headline blockquote leads with slogan plus descriptor (Chinese line included; the repo has no README.zh file), the "business ontology" paragraph now names the core and the no-inheritance/axioms/reasoner limit, "The other half is size" is kept as the proof, and the closing callout carries the four guardrail facts.
- `apps/docs/app/[lang]/page.tsx`: hero heading, `HOME_DESCRIPTION` (which feeds the meta, Open Graph, Twitter and JSON-LD descriptions, so they stay in sync), the "what that metadata is" paragraph, and the closing card. `apps/docs/lib/site.ts` carries no description or tagline and is unchanged. The docs app is English-only (`languages: ['en']`), so there are no localized hero strings.
- `content/docs/getting-started/glossary.mdx`: "Business Ontology" is now a two-way contrast (knowledge ontology vs. executable ontology; hosted ontology via the two existing bullets, kept) plus the core-versus-projections split.
- `content/docs/concepts/index.mdx` and `content/docs/concepts/metadata-driven.mdx`: one bridge sentence each, naming the split once.

## Guardrail facts, with evidence on main

- No object inheritance, axioms or reasoner: `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:1538-1541` (the retired-key message for `abstract`, ADR-0049: "object inheritance/abstraction is not implemented"). No axiom or reasoner feature exists in the docs corpus.
- Not a semantic layer over existing systems; federation is early and read-only by default: `content/docs/data-modeling/external-datasources.mdx:248`. "Early" is the card's wording.
- Views, dashboards, apps and i18n are projections: stated in the card; the existing "UI is a Projection" at `content/docs/concepts/index.mdx:93`.
- Code moves into the runtime: lifecycle hooks (`content/docs/concepts/metadata-driven.mdx:150`), action `body` (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:1101`), CEL (`README.md` validation row), constrained JSX (`README.md` sdui-parser row).

The 150k/100k figures appear in none of the retained copy, so the number discipline has nothing to violate.

## Acceptance notes

- Re-ran the grep for "hold whole", "small enough" and "business ontology" over `README.md`, `content/docs` and `apps/docs` (excluding references, releases and the dated blog post). Remaining hits are the intentional proof-line uses and the `metadata-driven.mdx` "Small Enough to Fit" section, which is a measurement section and stays.
- `apps/docs/lib/site.ts` `HERO_COVER.alt` still reads "the metadata framework for AI-written apps"; the card does not list it and it describes an image, so it is left as is. `HOME_TITLE` is likewise unchanged.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/docs build`: exit 0.
- Docs and README gates (frontmatter, route-spelling, nav-label, section-name, section-landing-index, doc-anchors, doc-authoring, single-h1, spec-enumerations, transcript-drift, locale-catch-all, redirects, nul-bytes, published-readme-links, corpus-claim-drift, role-word, vendor-version-stamps, org-identifier, docs-audit-scope, published-files, lint doc-formula-expressions and doc-security-posture): all exit 0.
- Changeset: none owed. `packages/**` is untouched; the PM applies `skip-changeset`.

## Reminder for the maintainer

The GitHub repository description lives outside git. Please paste the slogan and descriptor into it by hand:

- The ontology is the software. One executable business ontology. AI writes it, the runtime runs it, agents operate it, you own it.
- 本体即软件。一份可执行的业务本体。AI 写，运行时跑，Agent 用，归你所有。
